# searchstax_backup_schedule (Resource)





## Import

Import an existing backup schedule with `account_name/deployment_uid/schedule_id`.

```shell
terraform import searchstax_backup_schedule.example account_name/deployment_uid/schedule_id
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_name` (String)
- `days` (List of String)
- `deployment_uid` (String)
- `region_id` (String)
- `retention` (Number)

### Optional

- `collections` (List of String)
- `frequency` (Number)
- `time` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `schedule_id` (String)
